About Bridgett

Bridgett Tarpley is a devoted servant of God, encourager, and passionate voice of faith who has spent more than 20 years serving in ministry and encouraging others to walk boldly in their God-given purpose.

She is a minister, intercessor, and seer, as well as a mother of three and grandmother of one. Bridgett is passionate about pouring into people, speaking life into their dreams, and reminding them that their past does not have to determine their future.

With a heart for people and a deep love for God, she seeks to help others discover who they are in Christ and become all that God has called them to be.

  • 20+ years in ministry
  • Mother of three
  • Grandmother of one

The Path to Freedom

When Bridgett speaks and teaches, she walks people along the same road the Lord walked her: from confusion to clarity, and from bondage to the foot of the cross.

  1. 1

    Recognize the stranger's voice

    Naming the check in your spirit that says something is off, and why you are not crazy for noticing.

  2. 2

    Heal the wounds

    How unhealed pain affects discernment, and how inviting the Lord who heals begins real restoration.

  3. 3

    Discern healthy leadership

    The difference between leading and controlling, and what loving, approachable leadership looks like.

  4. 4

    Know the Shepherd's voice

    Building a relationship with God so His voice becomes as familiar as a parent's in a crowded room.

  5. 5

    Break free

    Repentance, forgiveness, and breaking legal rights and soul ties that have kept you bound.

  6. 6

    Stay free

    Healthy boundaries, the full armor of God, and walking in your new season without going back.

Follow the Good Shepherd

Every message points to Jesus, never to a personality. Bridgett also ministers in prayer and intercession over individuals, families, and congregations.

Where Bridgett ministers Church services, women's ministry gatherings, conferences, retreats, and prayer meetings.

It's Time to Break Up with Pain and Walk Into a Healthy, Restored Relationship

Have you ever felt that something was off, but you couldn't quite explain why? Are you tired of unhealthy relationships, spiritual confusion, and repeating patterns that keep you in bondage?

In My Sheep Know My Voice: Fleeing the Voice of a Stranger, Bridgett Tarpley combines personal experience with biblical insight to help readers recognize how unhealed wounds can affect discernment and how vulnerability can open the door to unhealthy influences. With honesty, wisdom, and compassion, she invites readers to examine the voices they have allowed to shape their lives and to distinguish the voice of the Good Shepherd from the voice of a stranger.

Through this journey, readers will explore the warning signs that something is wrong, the effects of unhealed wounds, the dangers of controlling spiritual leadership, and the path back to freedom, healing, and truth. More than a story about recognizing the wrong voice, this book is an invitation to return to the voice of Jesus, walk in freedom, and follow the path He has prepared.

Stop allowing the wrong voice to lead you into compromise, confusion, and discomfort. Let the Holy Spirit guide you in the path you should take.
